question: Should this remain a focused shared-profile queue fix, or should this PR also change provider preflight into active credential validation and carry the broader browser/session reliability changes?
rationale: The FIFO bug is bounded, but the current branch introduces public configuration and unrelated provider/network behavior whose compatibility and security tradeoffs require explicit repository-owner intent.

options.title: Narrow to queueing
options.body: Keep FIFO lease and cleanup fixes, preserve shipped defaults, split provider probing and unrelated reliability changes into separately reviewed PRs.

options.title: Approve the broad reliability bundle
options.body: Retain the combined scope only with explicit upgrade expectations, consistent documentation, provider compatibility coverage, and inspectable live proof.

options.title: Pause and restack
options.body: Close or supersede this branch after extracting several small PRs if narrowing the current head would be harder than reviewing clean replacements.

recommendation.title: Narrow to queueing
recommendation.body: Keep FIFO lease and cleanup fixes, preserve shipped defaults, split provider probing and unrelated reliability changes into separately reviewed PRs.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main browser lease and provider/CLI behavior history makes steipete the best available owner for the scope and compatibility decision.
